name: Marisol Trent
quote: First time filing didn't feel like guesswork. My preparer caught a home-office deduction I didn't even know existed.

name: Devon Okafor
quote: Quarterly estimates used to stress me out every single time. Now it's a fifteen-minute check-in and I move on with my day.

name: Priya Raman
quote: Got a letter from the IRS two months after filing. One call and it was handled — no extra charge, no panic.
